rejection_summary.title: Alien Code
rejection_summary.reason: Rejected after whole-runtime evidence review: intriguing cryptography/interdimensional premise, but insufficient evidence for a complete high-confidence DNA vector and an 82+ deterministic baseline score.

rejection_summary.title: Control
rejection_summary.reason: Rejected: single-room mystery has a strong hidden-system setup, but substantive reviews describe it as stretched, slow and increasingly confused, with weak payoff/execution evidence for the live profile.

rejection_summary.title: Project Ithaca
rejection_summary.reason: Rejected: alien-abduction mystery contains rule discovery and a government-research thread, but whole-runtime reviews characterize it as slow, convoluted, horror-forward and focused on trapped-character conflict rather than sustained scientific investigation.
